question:
Two cubes each of volume 125 cm³ are joined end to end. The total surface area of the resulting cuboid is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/743bb05a0d4c6bec8ee837fc5a003de84cd4df719565e020cca5fd10bafe4767.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two identical cubes are joined end to end, the visible surface area consists of 10 square faces (instead of 12 for two separate cubes).

Volume of one cube = a³ = 125 ⇒ a = 5 cm.

Area of one square face = a² = 5 × 5 = 25 cm².

Total Surface Area = 10 × 25 = 250 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 250 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of each cube = 125 cm³

Number of cubes joined = 2

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 125

⇒ a = 5 cm

When two cubes are joined end to end, a single cuboid is formed with dimensions:

⇒ Length of the cuboid (l) = a + a = 5 + 5 = 10 cm

⇒ Breadth of the cuboid (b) = a = 5 cm

⇒ Height of the cuboid (h) = a = 5 cm

⇒ TSA of the cuboid = 2 × (l × b + b × h + h × l)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (10 × 5 + 5 × 5 + 5 × 10)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (50 + 25 + 50)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 125 = 250 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 250 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area of a Cube

Volume = a³, Total Surface Area = 6a², Lateral Surface Area = 4a², where a is the side length.

Volume and Surface Area of a Cuboid

Volume = l × b × h, Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl), where l, b, and h are the length, breadth, and height respectively.

Joining Multiple Cubes

When 'n' identical cubes of side 'a' are joined end-to-end, the length becomes n × a, while breadth and height remain 'a'. The total surface area of the resulting cuboid is directly given by (4n + 2)a².
